name: Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official annual dates available; Fall 2027 deadline year not confirmed. EEB lab entry and MCB rotations differ, so no single admission model assigned.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall application
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual department deadline; older score-timing FAQ says December 15, so use earlier date.

applicationFee.note: Biology offers limited form-based waivers without a stated nationality restriction; confirm international eligibility. Central qualifying affiliation/service routes also apply, including EducationUSA Opportunity Funds/Fulbright; financial-need route is US-citizen-only.

english.toefl: 80 legacy / 4 new scale; department typically looks for 100 legacy
english.note: Department 100 is guidance, not hard minimum. Qualifying US or primary-English degree can exempt. Official agency scores due by deadline; no MyBest; central does not authorize unofficial score uploads.

documents: One-page research interests/career goals essay naming faculty fit
Uploaded official-copy transcripts; final official records after offer
Optional personal background/contributions statement, about 500 words
requirements.note: Recognized bachelor or equivalent; central B-average baseline, but Biology has no fixed numeric GPA cutoff. Broad biology or related science preparation; deficiencies may be remedied. EEB typically commits to lab, MCB rotates through one to three first-year labs. Two semesters teaching required. Interviews February; decisions February/March, responses April.

funding.note: All admitted students guaranteed at least five years of full stipend on 12-month contracts; full tuition throughout program, health and dental insurance. Current stipend amount not established on opened university pages.
